<div class="card-body">
'''Macroscan''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">望遠スキャン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して、相手のリザーブデッキのそばに配備する。１フォース消費して、好きなときにそのデッキの一番上のカードを見ることができる。場のどこかに“夜間状態”になっているカードがあれば、１枚ではなく上から３枚のカードを見ることができる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-17-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Macroscan (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Macroscan-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">電子双眼鏡の映像。目標の方位、高さ、距離が正確に表示される。暗視機能を内蔵する。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Long-range scan.

'''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy beside the opponent's Reserve Deck. You may spend 1 Force at any time to look at the top card of that deck. If a card anywhere on the table is in ‘nighttime conditions,’ you may look at the top three cards instead of one.

'''Lore:''' An electrobinocular image. The target's direction, height and distance are displayed accurately. It has built-in night vision.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a card on the table being in nighttime conditions; the English says nighttime conditions exist anywhere on the table. The Japanese lore describes the displayed direction, height and distance; the English specifies true and relative azimuth, elevation and range.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Macroscan]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
